assumptions: The expected lift is the model's hypothesis, not a measurement.
Break-even assumes the incentive is redeemed on every treated order.
final.diagnosis: Baseline conversion is 9.0%. This promotion needs a lift of 6.00% before it breaks even, because the incentive is charged on every treated order, not only the extra ones.
final.rationale: The economics can work: at the proposed lift this earns Rs.97,200 net. But the confidence rests on history, not on a measurement on this merchant, so the honest next step is a controlled test of 2,604 customers per arm at a cost of Rs.47,809. Rollout stays closed until that test clears the scaling rule.
